name: FewClicks
tagline: Games you can love in a few clicks.
description: FewClicks is an independent game studio making bright, bite-size games for phones, PCs and consoles. Easy to pick up, hard to put down, and always fun within a few clicks.

values.title: Tap and play
values.text: No 40-minute tutorials. If it takes more than a few clicks to have fun, we redesign it.

values.title: Bite-size joy
values.text: Short sessions, big smiles. Our games fit in a coffee break and still feel great after 100 hours.

values.title: Made with heart
values.text: A tiny team that sweats every bounce, pop and wobble so every click feels good.
